name: STREAM-VAE
full_name: STREAM-VAE: Dual-Path Routing for Slow and Fast Dynamics in Vehicle Telemetry Anomaly Detection
paper: STREAM-VAE: Dual-Path Routing for Slow and Fast Dynamics in Vehicle Telemetry Anomaly Detection. 2026 IEEE Intelligent Vehicles Symposium (IV)
description: A variational autoencoder for anomaly detection in automotive telemetry time-series data. STREAM-VAE model uses a dual-path encoder to separate slow drift and fast spike signal dynamics, and a decoder that represents transient deviations separately from the normal operating pattern.
